mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, status, language, source, log_path, file_count, health_url, source_root, owner_id, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, description, status, language, source, log_path, file_count, health_url, source_root, owner_id, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (id, name, description, status, language, source, log_path, file_count, health_url, source_root, owner_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{status}, #{language}, #{source}, #{logPath}, #{fileCount}, #{healthUrl}, #{sourceRoot}, #{ownerId})
